meta.title: Shubh Biodata — Free Marriage Biodata Maker
meta.description: Create a beautiful Hindu marriage biodata in minutes. Free, bilingual (English & Hindi), print-ready A4 PDF with 6 elegant templates. No sign-up — your data never leaves your browser.

landing.heroTitle: A beautiful marriage biodata in minutes
landing.heroSubtitle: Fill in your details, pick a template, and download a print-ready PDF — in English or Hindi. Made for Hindu families: gotra, manglik, rashi, nakshatra and more.
landing.step1Text: Personal, horoscope, family and contact details — guided sections in English or Hindi.
landing.step2Text: Six elegant templates, from traditional saffron to modern minimal. Live preview as you type.
landing.step3Text: One click gives you a crisp A4 PDF for WhatsApp or print. Share a link that pre-fills everything.
landing.templatesSubtitle: From a classic श्री गणेश invocation to a clean modern layout.
landing.privacyText: Everything runs in your browser. No accounts, no uploads, no servers — close the tab and nothing was sent anywhere.
landing.feature1Text: Both the app and the biodata itself work in English and Hindi, with correct Devanagari rendering.
landing.feature2Text: Gotra, manglik status, rashi, nakshatra, birth time & place — no squeezing them into 'other details'.
landing.feature3Text: Vector A4 output with selectable text — crisp on paper and on screen.
landing.feature4Text: MIT licensed. No watermarks, no paywalls, no premium templates.
landing.footerTagline: Made with respect for tradition and modern craft.
